generated.what_happened: During the Kansas City Chiefs' Sunday night game against the Indianapolis Colts at Arrowhead Stadium, tight end Travis Kelce scored his first touchdown of the 2026 NFL season. The viral moment marked Swift's second consecutive Chiefs game appearance of the season following the couple's marriage earlier this summer at Madison Square Garden.
